notes: Names printed without suffix (HEYWOOD ST. aside: STRAIGHT, ALFRED, DRAPER, COOK, KLOTTMAN, ELIZA, RUSH, TAFEL) recorded with 'Street'; HUKILL is printed with no suffix on a 10-15 ft strip and is kept as 'Hukill'. No bracketed old names on this half. Stephens Street (30', east of Massachusetts) is the piece the 1904 sheet 255 called 'Heywood Street (east of Massachusetts)'; in 1922 it is printed STEPHENS ST. and Heywood (50') ends at Massachusetts from the west; centres 76 px apart, so two T points. Marshall Av runs along the top with its north line off the paper: Marshall points are its south line (block corners, y~224-236) minus half the printed 60' (97 px at ~3.2 px/ft). At the top-left corner the page curls into the gutter (Marshall's south line drops from y~153 west of Colerain to ~182 east of it), so Colerain/Marshall (80,65) is uncertain by ~20 px. West McMicken Av bends from N to NW at the top right (bend vertex ~4739,356) and runs off the top edge; Marshall ends against its NW leg (T at the point where Marshall's centreline meets the leg's centreline, block corner 4472,236 chamfered); a short unnamed street leaves the bend to the NE (mostly off the plate, not recorded). 'ATLAS OF CINCINNATI' at the top right is the title, not a street. Colerain Av runs down the gutter side: at Heywood its west line is in the fold (x~245-300) and the street is only ~100 px wide, so Colerain/Heywood (297,907) is uncertain by ~15 px. Colerain points use the block corners, not the car tracks (the tracks run west of the centre). Klottman is two offset pieces, both printed KLOTTMAN ST.: a 40' piece from the old canal bed east to Halstead (lines 3011/3141) and a 25' piece from Halstead east to McMicken (lines 3450/3532), centres ~415 px apart; named '(west of Halstead)' and '(east of Halstead)'. Halstead St is the street from Straight south to Rush (label HALSTEAD near Rush, STREET near Straight); 40' in the north, ~50' near McMillan and Rush. South of Rush the 20' Rush Alley continues, its centre ~63 px east of Halstead's, so two T points on Rush. Hukill: the 10-15' strip labelled HUKILL runs from Rush north to Eliza; north of Eliza an unlabelled 15' alley on the same line with the same 12-inch sewer continues to McMillan; it is taken to be Hukill too (Hukill/Eliza recorded as cross; the two pieces are ~20 px out of line). Gene Alley (12') runs from Massachusetts west to x~839, where an unnamed 10' alley turns north to Heywood; no alley west of that. Queen City Av runs along the bottom with its south line at or beyond the neat line west of Bogan; Spring Grove/Queen City (92,7578): Spring Grove's east line is at x~232 (GEO. M. block) and its west part is compressed into the gutter, so the centre was placed by matching the pattern of pipes, sewers and tracks to the same crossing on 22-16L; uncertain by ~20 px. BOGAN ST. and OSWALDT ST. are printed horizontally just below Queen City as the names of streets leaving it to the south (only short stubs drawn); the 1904 sheet 235 had Bogen Street and Zwick on Queen City nearby. Oswaldt is drawn narrow (~58 px). West McMillan St and Straight continue east of McMicken (Straight's block corners are drawn east of McMicken; McMillan continues on the adjoining plate), so both recorded as cross; Tafel, Klottman, Eliza and Rush end at McMicken (nothing drawn beyond). Addison St (40', between the canal bed and Halstead) has no named crossings: it runs from a block line at y~4765 south to the 'City of Cin'n for Streets' strip at y~5715. The 'CITY OF CINCINNATI' strip near the bottom and the alley marked ALLEY between Halstead and McMicken are not recorded (unnamed). Thin solid lines in the streets are water pipes, dashed lines sewers. Gutter overlap ties with 22-16L: Colerain/Marshall, Colerain/Heywood, Cook/Alfred, Spring Grove/Queen City.
